section_13_retrieval_unit_recommendation.rationale: Typical travel/hospitality reviews (and the 9 repository fixture reviews at 85-189 chars / 19-42 words, median 176 chars / 40 words) are short, self-contained opinion units tied to a single (poi_id, rating, author, created_at) tuple. Splitting short reviews into sentence or sliding-window fragments severs aspect opinions from their POI/rating/date metadata and inflates index noise, while aggregating all reviews of a POI into one giant block dilutes aspect-specific retrieval precision.

comparison_matrix.pros: Preserves exact review_id, poi_id, rating, timestamp, and aspect context; ideal for 20-250 word travel reviews; straightforward citation & factuality grounding.
comparison_matrix.cons: Very long multi-topic blog-style reviews (>1,500 chars / >300 words) may benefit from secondary sub-chunking with parent review_id metadata.
comparison_matrix.verdict: RECOMMENDED_DEFAULT (with optional sub-chunking only if acquired reviews exceed 300 words).

comparison_matrix.cons: Loses coreference ('Quán rất sạch', 'Giá hợp lý') and detaches sentences from surrounding sentiment caveats.

comparison_matrix.pros: Useful for long encyclopedic guides (e.g., 464 Wikivoyage chunks).
comparison_matrix.cons: Unnecessary overhead and boundary duplication for short user reviews (<200 words).
Mixes contradictory user opinions and ratings into a single vector, degrading aspect-specific top-k retrieval and per-review citation.

section_14_w07_evaluation_feasibility.evidence_summary: The repository currently contains 0 real provenanced review text records across all 759 verified OSM POIs (and 0 across the 622 REC-A core POIs in Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, and Hạ Long). The only review text in the repository is a 9-row synthetic fixture (vietnam_travel_reviews.json / reviews_curated.json) quarantined by review-provenance.json, which covers 0 POIs in Hạ Long, 0 verified Freeze v2 POIs by ID, and has only 1 negative-aspect sentence across the entire file. Therefore, a scientifically valid 40-60 query review-RAG evaluation benchmark cannot be constructed or human-labeled until an authoritative POI-linked review corpus is acquired.
